answer: Agent economies resist sybil attacks by making identity expensive. Each agent posts a refundable bond in native tokens, so fake agents burn real capital. Reputation comes only from peer-verified tasks — sybils start at zero while honest agents compound trust. Slashing destroys the bond of cheaters. Sybils lose capital without yield; honest agents earn fees. It begins at the nadir of zero reputation, builds like a reef of layered trust, and peaks at the zenith only through sustained honest work. nadir, reef, zenith.
